verdict.rationale: Solid's own README says it is "naturally debuggable": a `<div>` is a real div, so you can inspect the rendering in browser devtools. It also says its minimal abstractions give direct access to the DOM. A hands-on user confirms that refs are just the elements. A complaint about Solid's alpha-quality dedicated devtools concerns a separate framework tool, not inspecting real DOM in browser devtools, so it does not contradict this story. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the browser-devtools debugging workflow, and independent hands-on reports specifically about inspecting Solid output in devtools.
